articles.title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
articles.summary: Andrej Karpathy, OpenAI co-founder and current Anthropic AI researcher, built HackerTube over a weekend using Claude's Opus 5.5 model. Claude filtered 43 million comments from 20 years of Hacker News and distilled them into 6,454 videos that keep getting recommended there .

articles.title: Saving a Vintage High-Voltage Power Supply From the Scrap Heap
articles.summary: [Mr Carlson’s Lab] saves a Fluke Model 407 high-voltage power supply from the scrap heap, and demonstrates carefully troubleshooting the vintage device to track the cause of the bad output down to a single capacitor.

articles.title: Enhancing Academic Advisement with Case-Based Reasoning
articles.summary: This research involved the study of an application of Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) in the field of academic advising. Academic advisement has been recognised as an important function of higher education.

articles.title: NormGym: Evaluating Normative Competence through Social Interaction
articles.summary: Normative competence, the ability to infer socially enforced expectations from interaction and adjust behavior accordingly, is essential for agents operating in unfamiliar human communities. Yet existing evaluations largely test whether agents can recognize or apply norms they may already know, rather than whether they can acquire previously unknown norms from social interaction.

articles.title: Apple Taking New Approach to Developing iOS 28 and macOS 28
articles.summary: Apple has made a change to its development process for iOS 28, macOS 28, and corresponding software updates, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. In his Power On newsletter today, he said Apple separates development of each year's new operating systems into three major stages.

articles.title: Aspect-wise Pairwise Tournaments for Test-Time Selection
articles.summary: Scaling test-time compute has proven highly effective at improving LLM reasoning. A popular method is best-of-n sampling, where a model generates many candidate solutions and one is selected.

articles.title: Decision Context: Persistent Behavioral Learning for AI Agents
articles.summary: LLM agents do not learn from corrections across sessions. A user fixes the same mistake at the start of every conversation. Existing agent memory systems primarily handle facts, such as preferences, entities, and conversational history, rather than procedural knowledge.

articles.title: Calibre adds new sources for finding free books & journals
articles.summary: Calibre 9.18 adds more accessibility tools to its editor, with Tools > Accessibility now letting you set the language for books and HTML files. Image descriptions, including those of inline SVGs, can be edited and EPUB Accessibility metadata modified.
